data.name: Ghazwan
data.gender_notes: Ghazwan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who fights for justice and righteousness. The name Ghazwan carries the meaning “Fighter, warrior” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ghazwan usually hope their child will grow to embody fighter, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A protector of truth and justice, a guardian of the faith
data.etymology: Ghazwan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fighter, warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghazwan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: غزوان
in_arabic.meaning: غزوان يعني الغزو والمعركة والانتصار في سبيل الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: غزوان هو اسم مشتق من غزوة، وهي المعركة التي يخوضها المسلمون في سبيل الله. يعتبر اسم غزوان من الأسماء التي تحمل معنى الشجاعة والانتصار في المعارك. وقد وردت كلمة غزوة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَلَقَدْ كُنتُمْ تَتَمَنَّونَ الْمَوْتَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَلْقَوُوهُ وَقَدْ رَأَيتُمُوهُ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ' (النساء: 73). يرمز اسم غزوان إلى الصبر والشجاعة في مواجهة التحديات.

in_urdu.name: غزوان
in_urdu.meaning: غزوان کا مطلب ہے غزوہ، معرکہ، اللہ کی راہ میں لڑائی
in_urdu.long_meaning: غزوان ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے غزوہ یا معرکہ۔ یہ نام اللہ کی راہ میں لڑائی اور انتصار کی علامت ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، غزوان کو ایک ایسے شخص کے نام کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے جو شجاع اور نڈر ہو، اور جو اللہ کی راہ میں لڑائی کے لیے تیار ہو۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء کے مسلم معاشروں میں بھی مقبول ہے، جہاں یہ شجاعت اور بہادری کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ग़ज़वान
in_hindi.meaning: ग़ज़वान का अर्थ है ग़ज़वा, लड़ाई, जिहाद
in_hindi.long_meaning: ग़ज़वान एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है ग़ज़वा या लड़ाई। यह नाम जिहाद और अल्लाह की राह में लड़ने की भावना को दर्शाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, ग़ज़वान को एक ऐसे व्यक्ति के नाम के रूप में देखा जाता है जो बहादुर और निडर हो, और जो अल्लाह की राह में लड़ने के लिए तैयार हो। यह नाम हिंदुस्तानी मुसलमानों के बीच भी लोकप्रिय है, जहां यह शौर्य और वीरता का प्रतीक माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: غزوان
in_pashto.meaning: غزوان د غزې، جګړې، او د الله په لاره کې د مبارزې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: غزوان د عربي نوم دی چې د غزې يا جګړې معنی لري. دا نوم د الله په لاره کې د مبارزې او بريا د نښانې په توګه ليدل کيږي. د افغان او پښتون دوديزې په منځ کې، غزوان داسې يو شخص د نوم په توګه ګڼل کيږي چې ډارې او زړور وي، او د الله په لاره کې د مبارزې لپاره چمتو وي.

in_english.name: Ghazwan
in_english.meaning: Ghazwan means victorious in battle, successful in jihad
in_english.long_meaning: Ghazwan is an Arabic name derived from the root 'ghazwa', which means 'battle' or 'raid'. In Islamic tradition, Ghazwan is associated with bravery, victory, and success in jihad or holy war. The name has its roots in Quranic etymology, where 'ghazwa' is mentioned in several verses, emphasizing the importance of striving in the cause of Allah. Historically, Ghazwan has been used to signify a person who is courageous, determined, and committed to their faith. Today, the name Ghazwan is used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing strength, resilience, and devotion.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ghazwan in the Islamic context carries a strong sense of honor, valor, and bravery. It is associated with the concept of "Ghazwa," an Islamic military expedition undertaken for the purpose of spreading the message of Allah and seeking martyrdom. Historically, numerous renowned Muslim warriors have carried this name, inspiring generations to uphold the values of valor and self-sacrifice.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ghazwan holds deep spiritual significance as it embodies the courage and determination of a believer to fight against injustice and promote righteousness. It symbolizes the struggle of the soul in seeking closeness to Allah and striving for His pleasure through noble deeds and self-sacrifice. The name echoes the words of Allah in the Quran, "Fight them; Allah will punish them by your hands and will disgrace them and give you victory over them and subdue them to you and make you inheritors of the land, [covering] what Allah has made permissible for you from it and give you other bases from which you may take provision. And Allah is Exalted in Might and possesses great wisdom." (Al-Anfal: 40)
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Fighter, warrior" symbolizes One who fights for justice and righteousness. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ghazwan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of fighter, warrior.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ghazwan ibn Asad was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and participated in several battles including the Battle of Uhud and the Battle of Hunayn.
